title: Creative Industries Economic Estimates: Focus on Employment
publisher: Department for Culture, Media and Sport
methodology: Computer-games estimates use SIC 58.21 and 62.01/1; source says annual variation can partly reflect small sample sizes.
assessment: Primary official source with exact 2011-14 rows. It is compatible in concept with the existing DCMS jobs series, subject to later-vintage revision check.
next_step: Main acceptance pass should compare the four rows against the current 2026 ODS before merging.

title: The UK Video Games Development Sector Surges Forward
methodology: Public release describes an extensive survey of UK games businesses with Games Investor Consulting analysis; it does not reproduce the complete commercial-report methodology.
assessment: Primary public source for two exact 2017 endpoints. It separates creative-staff FTE from total development workforce including contractors and separately lists indirect supported jobs.
access_status: Official WordPress API JSON downloaded; browser page returned 502
next_step: Add only the 2017 endpoints because the 2018 endpoints already exist in GB.json.

title: Think Global, Create Local: Regional Economic Impacts of the UK Games Industry
publisher: Ukie / Olsberg SPI / British Film Institute
methodology: Public page says it reuses BFI Screen Business underlying data and Green Book principles; its detailed model inputs were not inspected in this bounded pass.
assessment: Usable only as a separately labelled direct-company FTE benchmark. Do not use its 47,620 FTE total supported jobs as direct employment.
access_status: Full public HTML inspected; legacy direct PDF link returned 404
next_step: Recover and inspect the original BFI Screen Business report before treating contractor coverage or detailed scope as resolved.

title: UK Video Games Industry in Numbers
methodology: No underlying source, reference period, or worker-status treatment supplied in the inspected one-page fact sheet for its 26,000 direct-employment claim.
assessment: Current public claim but not sufficiently defined for a proposed observation. It is not evidence of a 2026 reference-year count.
next_step: Locate the cited underlying study or a methodological release before considering the 26,000 figure.

title: Economic Estimates: Employment January 2025 to December 2025 for DCMS sectors
publisher: Department for Culture, Media and Sport
methodology: Existing packet records APS annual-average filled jobs, small game-sector samples, and 2025 confidence intervals.
assessment: Forward sweep found no public 2026 reference-year game-only employment observation. This release is already represented in GB.json and is not duplicated here.
access_status: Existing packet's downloaded ODS and source record reviewed
next_step: Await the next DCMS employment release; retain uncertainty and accreditation cautions.
